article.title: Cláusula suspendida -는데...
article.part: Sintaxis discursiva compleja — 복합 담화 통사
article.chapter: Cadenas de cláusulas y suspensión — 절 연쇄와 문장 미완결

claims.summary: In Kim’s corpus of translated English movie scripts, Korean suspended clauses contained 317 tokens; nuntey represented 27.44% and was the most frequent form. The study reports its use for background information and for avoiding direct denials to a hearer.

locator.section: Kim (2019), abstract, lines 98–105; detailed result, lines 255–262.
locator.htmlLines: Kim (2019), abstract, lines 98–105; detailed result, lines 255–262.

links.notes: The article reports the corpus scope, counts and percentages, and the background/indirect-denial function for Korean nuntey in that dataset.
